title: Reusable orbital launch from landing demonstration to booster reflight
sourceNativeSummary: Orbital launch historically discarded major hardware. Falcon 9 first-stage landing and then the March 2017 SES-10 reflight demonstrated reuse of an orbital-class booster, turning recovery from a landing event into an operational lifecycle claim.
rivalOrBoundary: The trajectory separates technical recovery, inspection/refurbishment, reflight validation and service economics.
